items.prompt: Here is a picture fraction. It has two parts per whole unit.
Watch what happens to the size of each part as I increase the number of parts per whole unit.
items.demo: As I increase the number of parts per whole unit, the parts get *smaller*.

items.prompt: Now, as I decrease the number of parts per whole unit, the parts get bigger again.
items.demo: So, the more parts per whole unit, the *smaller* the size of each part. And, the fewer parts per whole unit, the *bigger* the size of each part.
